verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a unified candidate profile that brings resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history and consent status into one record. Nearby items do not establish it: the applications and audit-events API endpoints are developer building blocks, AI interview summaries are a separate feature, and the 'All-in-One' comparison slogan is generic marketing. A candidate-record story clearly applies to an ATS, so the absence of evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record
